  Δ(n,i) = (p_{n+i} − p_n) − (p_n − p_{n−i}) = Σ_{k=n}^{n+i−1} g_k − Σ_{k=n−i}^{n−1} g_k.

**Lemma R-new/L1 (telescoping identity).** For all n ≥ 2 and all 1 ≤ i < n,
  p_{n+i} + p_{n−i} − 2p_n = Δ(n,i).

*Proof.* p_{n+i} − p_n = Σ_{k=n}^{n+i−1} g_k and p_n − p_{n−i} = Σ_{k=n−i}^{n−1} g_k by telescoping; subtract. ∎

Consequently, for n ≥ 2,

  f(n) − 2p_n = min_{1≤i<n} Δ(n,i)

(the i = 0 term would give Δ = 0 and is correctly excluded by the canonical min over i < n; the small-n convention n ≤ 1 is handled separately and does not affect any limsup).

### Proof (affirmative close, both directions of the identity)

**(≥) Lower bound.** For each i with 1 ≤ i < n,
  g⁺_i(n) = g_n + g_{n+1} + ⋯ + g_{n+i−1} ≥ g_n, and similarly g⁻_i(n) = g_{n−1} + ⋯ + g_{n−i} ≥ g_{n−1},

  f(n) − 2p_n ≥ Δ_n.
